title: IdentityInfo — recent observations
query: IdentityInfo | where Timestamp >= ago(30d) | project Timestamp, AccountObjectId | order by Timestamp desc | take 20

title: IdentityLogonEvents — recent observations
query: IdentityLogonEvents | where Timestamp >= ago(30d) | project Timestamp, AccountObjectId | order by Timestamp desc | take 20

title: EmailEvents — sender with null fallback
query: EmailEvents | project NetworkMessageId, Sender=coalesce(SenderDisplayName, 'unknown') | take 20

title: EmailAttachmentInfo — recent observations

title: DeviceNetworkInfo — recent observations

title: DeviceLogonEvents — recent observations

title: DeviceProcessEvents — recent observations

title: DeviceNetworkEvents — recent observations

title: DeviceFileEvents — recent observations

title: DeviceRegistryEvents — recent observations

title: DeviceEvents — count by action
query: DeviceEvents | summarize EventCount=count() by ActionType | order by EventCount desc | take 20

title: CloudAppEvents — inspect dynamic fixture metadata
query: CloudAppEvents | extend Simulation=tostring(AdditionalFields.simulation) | where Simulation == 'fixture' | project AccountObjectId, ActionType, Simulation | take 20

title: AlertInfo — recent observations
query: AlertInfo | where Timestamp >= ago(30d) | project Timestamp, AlertId | order by Timestamp desc | take 20

title: AlertEvidence — recent observations
query: AlertEvidence | where Timestamp >= ago(30d) | project Timestamp, AccountObjectId | order by Timestamp desc | take 20

title: Join identity to device activity
query: IdentityInfo | distinct AccountObjectId, AccountUpn | join kind=inner (DeviceProcessEvents | distinct AccountObjectId, DeviceId) on AccountObjectId | project AccountObjectId, AccountUpn, DeviceId | take 20

title: Join messages to document hashes
query: EmailEvents | distinct NetworkMessageId, Subject | join kind=inner (EmailAttachmentInfo | distinct NetworkMessageId, SHA256) on NetworkMessageId | project NetworkMessageId, Subject, SHA256 | take 20

title: Join read-only alerts to entities
query: AlertInfo | distinct AlertId, Title | join kind=inner (AlertEvidence | distinct AlertId, AccountObjectId) on AlertId | project AlertId, Title, AccountObjectId | take 20

title: Join users to cloud activity
query: IdentityInfo | distinct AccountObjectId, AccountUpn | join kind=inner (CloudAppEvents | distinct AccountObjectId, ActionType) on AccountObjectId | project AccountObjectId, AccountUpn, ActionType | take 20
